title: Apple Vision Pro 2 leaks: what changed and is it worth it?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Apple Vision Pro 2 is a leap forward with its refined spatial computing and seamless integration with the Apple ecosystem.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the leaks show a lack of open protocols, locking users into Apple's walled garden and stifling third-party innovation.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: True, but its M3 chip and enhanced eye-tracking offer unmatched performance and user immersion compared to current competitors.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s short-term gain—without open APIs, developers can’t build on it, and the Vision Pro 2 risks becoming a niche product.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future belongs to open, interoperable tech—Apple’s closed approach isn’t sustainable.
